grid: alpha_j = (2j-1)/8000, j = 1..2000 -> alpha*f_ref = j - 0.5 MHz; exact rational P/Q with 8 | Q (uniform PMUX occupancy, circulant PHOS block, GOS-PHOS exactly decoupled); floor convention.  Values for 1-alpha are identical (mirror).

columns.kG: GOS: C_GOS / var(rho) (= 12 C_GOS), raw regressor, D = 0; > 0 restoring
columns.kP: PHOS: min Re eig of C_PHOS on the observable subspace / open-loop reference (= 8 min_m Re lambda_m)
columns.km1_re: mode m: 8 Re lambda_m (DFT mode of the circulant 8x8 PHOS block), m = 1..4
columns.km1_im: 8 Im lambda_m (needed for the finite-step criterion Re k > |k|^2/(2 tau))
columns.LSinf: large signal (A >> sigma_v, 1-bit comparator): worst over {GOS, PHOS m1c, m1s, m2c, m3c, m4} of <sgn(h_PD*d_v) z_v>/|<sgn(d_v) x_v>|; simulator physics (a = 0.03, eps seed 7, f_vco 16 GHz illustrative)
columns.LSinf_ac: same with the GOS regressor mean (1/2) removed
columns.kP_fx: filtered-x with the exact H_PD model
columns.kP_Ponly: remedy: integral path held (L2: Type-I K = Kp; L3: C1 >> C2 model)
columns.LSinf_Ponly_ac: large signal for P-only loop + mean-removed GOS regressor

threshold_note: inverted: kappa < -tau; dead zone: |kappa| <= tau (tau = 1e-3 or 1e-2)
